purpose: Prepare exact MCP/tool-registry metadata for private or unsubmitted agent-tool catalogs without launching hosted MCP, executing external publication, enabling monetization, contacting humans or publishing production keys.
plain_language_summary: This pack tells an AI agent, CRM workflow or tool-registry crawler how MachineSignal can be discovered and tested as a tool. Current mode is local adapter first: the customer machine runs the stdio adapter from the GitHub repository and the adapter calls the public HTTP API. Hosted public MCP is not live.

tool_registry_listing_fields.short_description: Machine-first lead scoring, target discovery and spend-control tool for CRMs, AI agents and automated RevOps workflows.
tool_registry_listing_fields.long_description: MachineSignal exposes lead opportunity scoring, Target Discovery, Deep Analysis, Action Pack, usage, order retrieval and payment-test reconciliation as machine-readable tools. The intended customer interface is a machine: CRM, AI agent, workflow automation, enrichment pipeline or software buyer. A machine can read the public manifests, install the local stdio adapter, create a limited sandbox customer, score domains, buy only the recommended beta add-on when spend gates allow it and retrieve structured JSON deliveries. Current state is sandbox/private-draft only: hosted public MCP is not live, monetization is disabled, public paid plans are not active, no live payment is executed, no fiscal invoice is issued, no external target contact is executed and no human outreach is allowed.
tool_registry_listing_fields.primary_user: Machine: CRM, AI agent, workflow, enrichment pipeline or software buyer.
tool_registry_listing_fields.human_role: Owner supervision, approval and audit only.

local_adapter_installation_flow: Run python mcp_adapter/machinesignal_mcp_server.py as local stdio adapter
Create a sandbox customer only if live sandbox testing is needed
Stop before hosted MCP publication, external registry submission, paid plan creation, live checkout, production key distribution or outreach

machine_decision.recommended_next_step: Use this pack to prepare owner-supervised private or unsubmitted MCP/tool-registry metadata. Stop before hosted MCP launch, irreversible registry submission, monetization, live checkout, production credentials or outreach.

latest_mcp_agent_registry_draft_rehearsa.recommended_next_step: Keep MCP/tool-registry as private draft/local adapter. Next decision: owner-supervised choice between building a hosted MCP endpoint or keeping local adapter and preparing unpublished registry metadata.
latest_mcp_agent_registry_draft_rehearsa.interpretation: A machine can discover the MCP manifest, registry draft, local adapter and evidence chain. The current channel is usable for private machine rehearsal, but it is intentionally not a live hosted MCP product and not monetized.
